name: Source excerpt
purpose: Show the lines of a source document that values were read from, with the lines that differ marked.
description: A titled excerpt of a statement, invoice, or form: its lines and values, with the lines that differ from the record marked and linked to their rows elsewhere on the screen.

title.description: The document, as people name it: Northgate Securities · March 2026 statement.

meta.description: Where in the document: account, page, section.

lines.description: The lines, in the document's order.

value.description: As written in the source, with its unit.

ref.description: The reference a value-diff row carries for this line.

flagged.description: The line differs from the record: marked in words and tone.

guidance.summary: Shows the lines of a source document beside the values read from it, so evidence sits next to what it proves.
useWhen: People confirm values extracted from a statement, invoice, or form, and need the source in view.
An audit or review needs the exact place a figure comes from, not a link to the whole document.

avoidWhen.text: The source is a list of references to open, not lines to read.
The evidence is prose that explains a finding.

states.label: Default
states.description: The document's lines, as written, with their values aligned.

states.label: Flagged
states.description: A line that differs from the record carries a Differs mark.

states.label: Linked
states.description: Pointing at a value-diff row with the same reference marks the line.
states.how: ref, matched by a value-diff row

dos.title: Lines as the source writes them
dos.description: Reviewers compare against the paper; reworded lines break the check.

dos.title: Only the lines that matter
dos.description: The lines values come from, and the totals that frame them.

donts.title: A card around it in a panel
donts.description: It already draws its own page; a second box adds nothing.

donts.title: Marking by colour alone
donts.description: The Differs mark says it in words, in any theme.

content: The title names the issuer, the document, and its period.

notes: A figure with a caption: the title names it, and the lines are an ordered list.
Flagged lines carry the word Differs, not only a tone.
Lines are not focusable; the value-diff row's source reference brings a line into view and marks it.

composition.defaultVisible: The lines values come from and the totals around them.
composition.density: Up to 24 lines; the full document opens elsewhere.
composition.contentLength: Lines as written in the source.

redundantWith.reason: Links to the document beside its excerpt.

mistakes: Wrapping it in a panel or a card: it is already one.
composition.responsive: It follows the differences on a narrow screen.
